contract.streams: both source clips play in lockstep t=0..120; pure phases verbatim

design.exact_op_definition: (shader, uniforms, easing, onset/release, flip, swap) — ALL frozen across the op's 10 clips, timing included
design.reference_pairing: DYNAMIC at train time: ref != target drawn from the SAME op_id's 10 clips. No dedicated reference render exists. Endpoint-disjointness across the 10 makes every (ref,target) draw content-disjoint by construction.
design.retry_policy: content-pair SWAP only; timing is NEVER redrawn (it is part of op identity). Budget 25 pair attempts to fill 10 slots, else the op is DROPPED and logged.

holdout.note: eval only, never trained. Each holdout retains a same-genre cousin in training so the probe tests unseen-operator generalisation, not removed capability. The ffmpeg-xfade family is the separate cross-engine probe.

gate.tau_provenance: inherited from exp_077 D2_TAU.json; re-calibrated on our own audit before the mass render is accepted (hand-off spec: 'tau recalibrated on OUR audit')
